description: This file defines the 'Field' interface in the Apache Commons Math library, representing a mathematical field with methods to obtain zero and one elements, and to retrieve the runtime class of field elements.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: An interface representing a mathematical field, with methods for retrieving additive and multiplicative identities and the runtime class of field elements.

methods.name: getZero
methods.description: Returns the additive identity element of the field.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Returns the multiplicative identity element of the field.

methods.name: getRuntimeClass
methods.description: Returns the runtime class of the field elements.
